description: This Java class acts as a command handler for updating charge definitions in the Fineract framework. It is annotated to process 'UPDATE' actions on 'CHARGE' entities, leveraging the ChargeWritePlatformService to perform the update operation.

classes.name: UpdateChargeDefinitionCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class implementing a command handler for updating charge definitions, annotated to specify command type and transaction management.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to update a charge by invoking the charge write platform service's updateCharge method.
